title: Sunforge Manufacturing — call log & technical capture
content:
TL;DR:
- Product + infra kickoff with Sunforge (industrial controls + telemetry).
- They want private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem gateway) to process sensor telemetry and edge alerts; strong requirement for sub-150ms tail latency for short chat-style operator queries against indexed logs.

Attendees:
- Sunforge: Lena Park (CTO), Amir Soltani (Platform), Carla Green (Ops lead)
- Redwood: Samira (SE), Evan (SRE), Maya (Private deployments PM)

Business context / success metrics:
1) Replace brittle rules engine for operator triage; accuracy target: reduce false positives by 30% vs current rules.
2) Latency: 95th percentile <= 150ms for small retrieval+generate flows (<=512 tokens).
3) Cost sensitivity: pooling of requests across 500 daily active operators; burst to 2k concurrent during incidents.
4) Data residency: all telemetry must remain inside EU region and behind their VPC firewall.

Technical notes:
- Data flow: edge sensors -> internal Kafka -> Elastic for indexing. Desired pattern: Redwood Private in customer's VPC connects to Elastic via private peering; model inference should run in dedicated private cluster (no outbound internet).
- Models considered: open Llama-family 7B/13B variants for nightly summarization jobs; a smaller quantized 4-bit 3B for real-time operator queries.
- Hardware: customer prefers H100s for heavy batch jobs; for realtime they'd tolerate A10G / T4-like capacity if latency SLOs met. Need to validate KV cache efficiency on smaller GPUs.
- Sequence lengths: typical prompt+context ~800 tokens for retrieval-augmented answers (RAA); however many queries will be short (<=128 tokens). Plan for dynamic padding and multi-queue batching.
- Caching: strong win expected from prefix caching (same operator prompts + overlap). Evaluate TTL=1h for session-level cache.

Constraints & gotchas called out by Sunforge:
- No outbound connections allowed from inference nodes; control plane must support air-gapped package or allow deployment via customer-provided bootstrap image.
- Compliance: need KMS integration with their HSM (YubiHSM mention) and Enterprise Audit logs (retain 1 year).
- Network: strict MTU and packet inspection rules break gRPC keepalives — SRE to validate longer TCP timeouts vs Redwood defaults.
- Burst profile unpredictable (incident-driven). They asked about sudden CPU/GPU scheduling preemption policies.

Open questions (to resolve next call):
1) Can we run the control-plane agent entirely offline with one-time handshake? (Action: Evan to draft offline-install proposal).
2) Quantized model accuracy: can 3B 4-bit meet their triage quality bar? (Action: Maya/Eval team to run 1000-sample evaluation using Sunforge prompt set).
3) Autoscaling policy for burst: prefer pre-warm + fast scale up (90s target). Need to document cold-start behavior and warm pool sizing.
4) Legal: contract team needs data flow diagram for their privacy officer.

Immediate action items (owners + rough ETA):
- Samira: capture prompt samples and ask Sunforge for 150 labeled triage cases (due 2025-11-11) -> JIRA-INF-4821.
- Evan: prototype offline-control-plane install doc (initial draft 2025-11-14).
- Maya: kick off eval job for 3B quantized model with Redwood Evaluate harness; smoke results by 2025-11-18.
- Diego: network checklist for MTU/keepalive gotchas; run connectivity test with their infra team (by 2025-11-10).

Notes for internal follow-up / engineering hand-off:
- Serving runtime: recommend enabling per-customer routing policy that pins Sunforge requests to the private cluster; fallback policy: prefer smaller quantized model when dedicated heavy model capacity unavailable.
- Batching: configure two queues: latency queue (max batch size 8, max_wait 15ms) and throughput queue (max batch 32, max_wait 50ms) to satisfy mixed workload.
- Observability: expose token-level cost and per-request trace id; Sunforge wants integration with their Splunk instance — add Splunk webhook item to integration checklist.
- Security: prepare HSM/KMS integration template and a sample audit log export format (CSV + signed digest).

Follow-up meeting scheduled: 2025-11-12 09:30 UTC (tentative) — prep: bring initial eval numbers and offline-install playbook.

Misc notes / raw snippets captured during call (verbatim):
- "We cannot have model weights leaving our VPC" — Lena.
- "During grid outages, operators need fast summaries; if it takes >200ms it's a non-starter" — Carla.
- "If you can show us caching reduces token spend by 40%, we're closer to sign-off" — Amir.

References & artifacts to attach to handoff: 1) sample prompt spreadsheet (ask Sunforge for), 2) eval harness link (will attach after run), 3) draft offline install playbook (Evan).

Shelf items / long-term considerations:
- Explore edge inference for ultra-low latency at remote sites (local small CPU quantized runner + periodic model sync).
- Consider multi-region replication of private control plane for high availability if they scale beyond EU into APAC.

End of capture.

(Internal note: keep this doc lightweight — expected to evolve rapidly. Rename to final integration brief once we have eval results and legal sign-off.)
